title: Testaments of the Twelve Patriarchs — Hobah Edition
about: Twelve testamentary discourses attributed to the sons of Jacob. The surviving Greek corpus is transmitted through Christian manuscripts and contains material whose Jewish, Christian, and redactional layers remain disputed. Hobah keeps the received material rather than silently deleting passages judged secondary.

translation.status: Hobah complete modern-English edition from a public-domain historical English witness
translation.base_text: R. H. Charles's public-domain English translation of the Testaments of the Twelve Patriarchs in The Apocrypha and Pseudepigrapha of the Old Testament (1913), consumed from a pinned structured-text mirror in the scrollmapper/bible_databases_deuterocanonical repository
translation.method: Complete conservative Hobah modernization of the public-domain Charles witness. Archaic pronouns and verbal forms are normalized while content, testament order, chapter order, and received disputed passages are retained. This is a Hobah edition of a public-domain English witness, not a newly collated Greek critical translation.
translation.confidence: High for preservation of the public-domain witness; medium for the underlying ancient text because recension and interpolation questions are substantial
translation.notes: All twelve patriarchal testaments are retained. Suspected Christian interpolation is not silently removed. The Scrollmapper repository is used only as a pinned transport/structure mirror; the rights basis asserted here is the underlying 1913 Charles text, not a claim that every contribution in the mirror has an independent open-source licence.
translation.license_note: Charles's 1913 English translation is public domain. Hobah modernization is newly prepared for this project. The mirror is not treated as the legal source of the underlying translation rights.
